guidance.heading: Outlook
section: ◦(+) We expect record crushing in 2026, with mid-double-digit growth versus 2025 on greater cane productivity (including Caarapó from September 1 and assuming normal weather through year-end). Our continuous harvest model ensures any cane left unharvested at year-end will be crushed from January onwards.
◦(+) As of this date, 100% of our 2026 sugar production is hedged at an average of 16.5 cts/lb, and 41% of 2027 production at 18.3 cts/lb. Unhedged volumes provide upside exposure in 1H27.
◦(+) We are accelerating ethanol sales to capture stronger prices, supported by a higher demand due to the low parity at the pump.
